column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# build/BuildNugets.sh packs in this order, the package tests read it. Adding a package means
# adding a row here and a project under src/ — nothing else keeps a second copy of the list.
# Rows are in dependency order. Unlike Net.Agora.Android's packages, these don't share a
# "Net.OpenTok.<id>.Android" naming template — the main package is OpenTok.Net.Android itself, and
# the dependency package is OpenTok.Net.webrtc.Dependency.Android — so each row spells out its own
# project directory name (identical to its PackageId) rather than a bare id BuildNugets.sh expands.
# The transformers row depends on nothing here, deliberately: it carries native payload only (see
# src/OpenTok.Transformers.md), and a consumer adds it alongside OpenTok.Net.Android only if it
# wants background blur, background replacement or noise suppression — which costs ~70 MB.
#   id       short label used only for build log messages
#   project  directory under src/, and the resulting PackageId (project dir == project file basename)
#   deps     other ids in this repository it depends on, comma separated, or -
